column1: # The P1 row set (plan N0, frozen 2026-10-15). Source: the row names of kaluza-core's gates
# kaluza-amf-ueransim, kaluza-smf-ueransim and kaluza-smsf as scored in phase-2-final
# kept verbatim: it is the UE_IMPL parity contract. Only the names are taken; no gate code.
# Rows named ksim-p1.* are kaluza-sim's own (sim behaviour the reference gates cannot see).
#   observable  sim: kaluza-sim's own evidence (events, ksim-ctl output, its pcaps) decides the row;
#               core: only the core's state, logs or metrics can (not a kaluza-sim row; P4 parity)
#   trigger     sim | dn (a ping from the DN host) | subscription (a provisioned sub-block) |
#               oam (a core-side change) | core-restart | operator-api | fault | roaming | ims
#   cores       where a P1 row runs: stub, open5gs, kaluza; open5gs=allow marks rows the Open5GS
#               control cannot serve (no SMS over NAS, decision D3), listed in gates/allow/open5gs.tsv
#   milestone   where the row is first scored; mutant: the KSIM_MUTATIONS switch that must fail it
#               ('-' until N16 assigns one); evidence: what the sim reads
